headline: Congress returns from recess on Monday with a pro forma Senate session and House meeting as lawmakers reconvene for the fall legislative push.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on August 27, convening at 8:00 a.m. and adjourning just 33 seconds later. No legislative business was conducted as Congress was in its August recess period.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met on August 27 for a brief session lasting just 3 minutes, during which 34 public bills and 8 resolutions were introduced. The chamber filed 18 committee reports on a range of issues including tax-exempt organization disclosures, Indian Health Service improvements, and renewable energy measures, but no votes were held.
